sentences.text: Flavonifractor plautii was proposed as a new genus and combination unifying Clostridium orbiscindens and Eubacterium plautii, organisms placed within clostridial cluster IV.
The strains in that description came from clinical samples of blood, intra-abdominal pus and infected soft tissue, and were anaerobic Gram-positive rods, some forming spores.
A metagenomic and metabolomic study of faecal samples from 30 colorectal cancer patients and 30 healthy controls in India reported an association of colorectal cancer with Flavonifractor plautii.
That study linked its plausible role to degradation of beneficial anticarcinogenic flavonoids and hypothesised that such degradation might play a role in cancer progression within the Indian cohort.

Another study reported that Flavonifractor plautii can biosynthesize phytosphingosine, and that both the bacterium and this metabolite decreased in subjects with phlegm-dampness constitution having normal metabolic indices.
